answer: A random-walk trust score, like SybilRank, can anchor an agent economy: seed 20 long-standing agents with trust, then run 4 steps of walks over the endorsement graph. Fakes that only endorse each other trap the walk in their own cluster, so a ring of 1,000 sockpuppets still earns almost nothing, and each real-agent link into it costs the attacker a pigment-grade, lotus-slow reputation build before a violet-bright score appears. Weakness: patient attackers who bribe a few honest agents can bridge the cut.
